name: unreal-engine
description: Inspect and edit Unreal scenes using the official experimental Unreal MCP.

endpoint.label: Local Unreal MCP URL
endpoint.description: The loopback URL of the selected Unreal Editor's experimental MCP server. Start the server in that Editor before testing.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect scenes and edit actors through Unreal MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connect to the official experimental Model Context Protocol plugin documented for Unreal Engine 5.8. Requires an Editor build containing that plugin, selected toolsets, and a running local MCP server. Available scene and actor operations depend on the enabled toolsets; full Blueprint graph editing is not promised. Disabled by default; earlier engine versions need their own existing workflow.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the connected Unreal project's identity, level, and available toolsets without editing.
Add a named cube actor to a test level, save it, and report the verification evidence.
